build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball passing through a hole in the ground
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable scale and position in the scene
create_static_bar: create a static bar object with configurable scale and position for obstacles
update_task_relationships: update the task to define spatial relationships like TOUCHING between two bodies
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to BALL for the task scene
